signal: Sensi.AI raised a $45M Series C in October 2025 to expand go-to-market and evolve into a full AI operating system for senior care, after 400% revenue growth.

email.body1:
Ardi, saw Sensi raised its $45M Series C and is scaling go-to-market after 400 percent revenue growth.

Growth that fast usually means more agencies and facilities in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sensi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ardi, quick follow-up for Sensi.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sensi needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ardi, last bit of proof for Sensi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sensi's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ardi, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise, timing is everything, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Sensi's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
